data.title: Sobha Estates
data.about:
Sobha Hartland 2 in Dubai is a magnificent refuge that combines natural regions with daily life. It is a residential community that will mix in with your home seamlessly, with over 1 million square feet of dedicated green space that includes artistically groomed open areas, tree-lined walks, and linear parks. Mansions, 5-Bedroom Villas, and 6-Bedroom Villas are among the opulent houses available at the woodland refuge.

Sobha Estates is a private gated enclave inside Sobha Hartland 2 that consists of three clusters. Life here is about relaxation and peace, with two turquoise lakes for residences and villas. At night, stroll down the beachfront, indulge in beach activities, and relax while listening to the tranquil waves. This area is great for families searching for the best educational and medical services.

location_tile.title: A Premium Location
location_tile.heading: Location
location_tile.description:
Sobha Hartland 2 is located on the right side of Sobha Hartland 1 and faces the Ras Al Khor Wildlife Sanctuary, with easy access to Ras Al Khor Road and Al Ain Road, which blends smoothly into Al Khail Road and other major landmarks in Dubai.

  • 02 Mins from 2 International Schools
  • 05 mins from Ras Al Khor Wildlife sanctuary
  • 10 Mins from Al Meydan Racecourse
  • 12 Mins from Business Bay
  • 15 Mins from Downtown and Burj Khalifa
